day_shape: 68 items on October 7 eve: UK court charges three Iranians with spying on Iran International journalists, IDF raised to high alert citing Hamas attack intelligence, Saudi-backed forces reverse Houthi gains at Bab el-Mandeb, Putin-Pezeshkian meeting set for 9 October.

threads.label: October 7 third anniversary posture
threads.summary: Defence Minister Katz ordered the IDF onto heightened Gaza alert citing intelligence Hamas may attempt attacks on the October 7 anniversary, and Netanyahu warned of a "tremendous force" response before the 27 October election. The IDF reported demolishing a 1.5km tunnel in northern Gaza, and 835 plaintiffs filed a NIS 5.151 billion suit against the PA and PLO.

threads.label: Regime marks Al-Aqsa Storm anniversary
threads.summary: The IRGC and Defa Press issued statements marking three years since the October 7 2023 attack, framing it as having "shattered the security structure of the Zionist regime," and Khamenei's office circulated a message on takbir uniting resistance fighters. Islamic Jihad's Ziyad al-Nakhalah claimed over 80,000 Palestinian martyrs, and IRIB cited Channel 12 polling that 65% of Israelis see it as Israel's greatest security defeat.

threads.label: UK Iran International spying case
threads.summary: UK prosecutors told a London court three Iranian men spied on Iran International journalists on behalf of Iran's foreign intelligence service to prepare serious violence against at least one target. Separately, British police arrested a 22-year-old in London on suspicion of preparing terrorist acts linked to a suspected Iran-backed drone plot against RAF Fairford, which prompted the US to remove its B-1 bombers.

threads.label: Yemen: Bab el-Mandeb front shifts
threads.summary: Saudi-backed Yemeni government forces reversed weeks of Houthi gains around Bab el-Mandeb on Monday, with Jerusalem Post citing video of armoured vehicles driving over opposing fighters, and two Saudi airports were reported targeted. Defa Press and Houthi political bureau member Hizam al-Asad claimed Yemeni fighters killed the commander of the Saudi-backed 35th armoured regiment and took heights at Jabal Matran and Jabal Thumran.

threads.label: Iran economy, oil ministry transition
threads.summary: Iran International reported the oil minister's departure as exports fell sharply with billions in sanctioned crude sales in question; IRIB covered the acting minister's introduction and his statement that returning trust currency is the Central Bank's responsibility. Central Bank governor Hemati told IRIB $13bn of $21bn in unreturned foreign currency would come back in coming months, with money supply growth down to 51% and FX provision at $24.9bn, 12% below last year.

threads.label: Domestic repression and executions
threads.summary: Iran International reported Iran has executed nearly two people a week in political and security cases since January protests with 194 facing death sentences, and that a 38-year-old was sentenced to death in Bojnurd over protest support. Security forces are reported raiding slain protesters' bedrooms, Tehran police warned cafes over music and hookah, and hardline cleric Kharrazi was released on bail.

threads.label: US-Iran information and diplomatic friction
threads.summary: CENTCOM publicly denied Iranian state media claims that a US Navy MH-60R helicopter crashed in the Red Sea, saying all aircraft and personnel are accounted for, as Iran International reported US-Iran diplomacy is "back to square one." The US State Department said 11 Western Hemisphere nations condemned Iranian "terrorist actions," Russia announced Putin will meet Pezeshkian in Turkmenistan on 9 October, and Tehran summoned the French ambassador over student protest crackdowns.

events.title_en: Confirmed: death of commander of 35th armoured regiment of Saudi-backed mercenaries. Hizam al-Asad, member of the political bureau of Yemen's Houthi movement: Yemeni fighters, by liberating the strategic heights of Jabal Matran and Jabal Thumran, have taken control of vital axes in Haifa, Al-Mowasat, Sami, Al-Tarba and Al-Sulo. In the course of these clashes, Abdulrahman al-Shamsani, commander of the 35th armoured regiment of invading mercenaries, has been killed and the bases of this regiment along with large quantities of military equipment and armoured vehicles have been seized as spoils. With the complete liberation of the villages of Quds, Bani Youssef and Al-Sulo front, the towns of Al-Mowasat and Sami have been completely cleared and important communication routes in the region have been secured.

Central Bank governor: from the beginning of year 1404 to now, nearly 21 billion dollars in foreign currency has not returned to the economy. Some 13 billion dollars of this amount is documented and specified, and will return to the country's economy in coming months. On average, 195 million dollars per day are exchanged at the exchange centre, either directly or indirectly.

events.title_en: 30 per cent increase in foreign currency provision for medicines. Central Bank governor: up to mid-Mehr of this year, approximately 24.9 billion dollars in foreign currency provision has taken place. In the corresponding period last year, total foreign currency provision up to this time was 28 billion dollars; that is, we have had a 12 per cent decrease this year. This decrease has been mainly in the industrial sector and does not include essential goods. In the medicine sector, foreign currency provision has been 30 per cent higher than last year.

events.title_en: Qalibaf: a spectre of terror awaits the American economy. Parliament speaker, responding to remarks by the US Treasury Secretary, posted an economic meme asking: 'Are you ready for your soul to be possessed?' In this image, graphs of oil prices and gas oil, consumer confidence and housing purchasing power are arranged to form the shape of a spectre; with the implication that you don't need to wait for Halloween to be frightened; sometimes it's enough just to open the economics page. In the image is David Zaroff, a new special adviser to Bessent and a supporter of interest rate cuts, the same person who said he wouldn't cut his hair until the Federal Reserve lowered interest rates.

events.title_en: Ziyad al-Nakhalah: Palestinian people continue resistance. Secretary-general of Islamic Jihad said: the enemy disregarded all peace plans and proposals and continued its aggression against the Palestinian people.
